title: Principles of Real Estate — Michigan Salesperson Prelicensure

_completion_rules_notes.final_exam_required_by_state: MCL 339.2504 and R 339.22141 to R 339.22158 do not prescribe a final examination. R 339.22154(2)(c) records a grade only 'if an examination is required to determine successful completion', which leaves the question to the school. StateCourse administers one as a provider standard; no Michigan document may describe it as a state requirement.
_completion_rules_notes.proctoring_required_by_state: Michigan's identity requirement attaches to certificate issuance and to the accuracy of reported attendance (R 339.22154(5)), not to supervised examination. California's proctor rule is not imported.
_completion_rules_notes.student_record_retention: R 339.22154(1) requires the record to be permanently maintained. Michigan records are never aged out.
_completion_rules_notes.course_approval_term_days: R 339.22143(1). Renewal is filed not less than 60 days before expiry under R 339.22143(3).

rule_numbering_note: The Real Estate Brokers and Salespersons general rules were renumbered and largely rescinded effective June 4, 2025 (2025 MR 12). Citations here use the current numbering, R 339.22141 to R 339.22158. LARA's course approval form, rev. 3/23, still cites the superseded Rule 618 and Rule 626.
configuration_scope: Michigan only; no setting is inherited by another state.
